body:
Unfinished work now reaches GitHub every five minutes on this public repo too: a part's work is committed on its own branch and pushed there, anyone else's goes to a wip branch. Nothing that looks like a token or a private key ever leaves: that save is refused and the session is told why. A session that takes over a lost one starts from whichever is newer, the branch or the last save, and says which.

### What changed
- **kit/landing.py `save`**: `wip: auto` (the default) now pushes on any repo; the old "private only" rule and its GitHub lookup are gone. Before a push it reads every line the save adds to what origin already has (`secret_hits`): GitHub/AWS/Slack/Anthropic-OpenAI/Google/Stripe/Hugging Face tokens, private keys, a long password or key in the clear. A hit refuses the push (kept in the clone) and names file:line and kind. A line ending in `kit: not a secret` is allowed. Secret-named files (.env, *.pem, id_rsa...) are left out and named in the save's commit message and text.
- **A part's save** (`resume --role part` marks the branch in .kit/run/part-branch.json, or KIT_POST): `kit.py checkpoint --on-step-branch --push`, the same 5-minute clock, detached. The checkpoint runs the same secret check before committing (a hit commits nothing, unstages) and before pushing (commits origin lacks). Pushed as `HEAD:<branch>`, never forced; if origin refuses, the save falls back to wip/<branch>.
- **kit/hooks/kit_wip.py**: the separate 15-minute checkpoint clock is gone (the save does it). A refused or untaken save is told to the session once (additionalContext, or a systemMessage at Stop).
- **Takeover** (`take_step_branch`, used by every part start incl. `launch --take` and web_takeover): looks at wip/<branch> at origin and here; a save newer than the branch that continues it is put in the working tree uncommitted, and the first lines say "Started from your step's last save ..." or "Started from your step's branch ... the newest". With local changes or a diverged branch it only says so. `_saved_mins` (CL49's claim) now also counts checkpoint commits on the branch as a sign of life.

### Found on the way
- A test (test_train_and_task_train) runs `resume --role part` with a test board and the real repo: it would have marked this clone as part B15. Marking is skipped when a test board is given.
